#!/bin/sh
# kanareika-collect 1.2.3 — GENERATED by `kanareika helper`, do not edit by hand.
# Read-only data collection for the Kanareika security audit. Allowed in sudoers as the only command
# for the audit user. Each operation takes a fixed number of arguments, each one validated.
set -u
export PATH=/usr/local/sbin:/usr/local/bin:/usr/sbin:/usr/bin:/sbin:/bin
umask 077
die() { echo "kanareika-collect: $*" >&2; exit 64; }
op="${1:-}"; [ $# -gt 0 ] && shift
case "$op" in
  dmesg)
    [ $# -eq 0 ] || die 'bad args'
    dmesg -T --level=emerg,alert,crit,err,warn 2>&1 | tail -n 400
    ;;
  journal-errors)
    [ $# -eq 0 ] || die 'bad args'
    journalctl -p err --since -7d --no-pager -o short-iso -q 2>&1 | tail -n 1000
    ;;
  sshd-config)
    [ $# -eq 0 ] || die 'bad args'
    sshd -T 2>&1
    ;;
  sshd-config-user)
    [ $# -eq 1 ] || die 'bad args'
    printf '%s' "$1" | grep -Eqx '[a-z_][a-z0-9_.-]{0,31}' || die 'bad arg 1'
    sshd -T -C "user=$1,host=kanareika-probe,addr=203.0.113.10" 2>&1 | grep -Ei '^(passwordauthentication|kbdinteractiveauthentication|challengeresponseauthentication|usepam) '
    ;;
  password-users)
    [ $# -eq 0 ] || die 'bad args'
    awk -F: '($2 != "" && $2 !~ /^[!*]/) {print "PW:"$1}' /etc/shadow
    ;;
  authorized-keys)
    [ $# -eq 0 ] || die 'bad args'
    awk -F: '{print $1" "$6}' /etc/passwd | while read u h; do for f in "$h/.ssh/authorized_keys" "$h/.ssh/authorized_keys2"; do [ -f "$f" ] && sed "s|^|K:$u:$f:|" "$f"; done; done 2>/dev/null
    ;;
  auth-log)
    [ $# -eq 0 ] || die 'bad args'
    { journalctl -u sshd -u ssh --since -30d -o short-iso --no-pager -q 2>/dev/null; for f in $(ls -1tr /var/log/secure /var/log/secure.1 /var/log/secure-[0-9]* /var/log/auth.log /var/log/auth.log.1 2>/dev/null | grep -v '\.gz$'); do cat "$f"; done; } | grep -E 'sshd\[[0-9]+\]: (Accepted |Failed |Invalid user )' | tail -n 150000; echo @@auth-readable@@
    ;;
  sockets)
    [ $# -eq 0 ] || die 'bad args'
    ss -Hltnup 2>/dev/null || ss -ltnup 2>/dev/null | tail -n +2
    ;;
  firewall)
    [ $# -eq 0 ] || die 'bad args'
    printf '\n@@%s@@\n' firewalld_state; firewall-cmd --state 2>&1; printf '\n@@%s@@\n' firewalld; firewall-cmd --list-all-zones 2>/dev/null | head -n 400; printf '\n@@%s@@\n' nft; nft list ruleset 2>&1 | head -n 600; printf '\n@@%s@@\n' iptables; iptables -S 2>&1 | head -n 600; printf '\n@@%s@@\n' iptables_nat; iptables -t nat -S 2>&1 | head -n 300; printf '\n@@%s@@\n' ip6tables; ip6tables -S 2>&1 | head -n 200; printf '\n@@%s@@\n' ufw; ufw status verbose 2>&1
    ;;
  docker-version)
    [ $# -eq 0 ] || die 'bad args'
    [ -n "${DOCKER_HOST:-}" ] || [ -S /var/run/docker.sock ] || for s in /run/user/*/docker.sock; do [ -S "$s" ] && export DOCKER_HOST="unix://$s" && break; done; docker version --format '{{json .}}'
    ;;
  docker-ps)
    [ $# -eq 0 ] || die 'bad args'
    [ -n "${DOCKER_HOST:-}" ] || [ -S /var/run/docker.sock ] || for s in /run/user/*/docker.sock; do [ -S "$s" ] && export DOCKER_HOST="unix://$s" && break; done; docker ps -a --no-trunc --format '{{json .}}'
    ;;
  docker-running)
    [ $# -eq 0 ] || die 'bad args'
    [ -n "${DOCKER_HOST:-}" ] || [ -S /var/run/docker.sock ] || for s in /run/user/*/docker.sock; do [ -S "$s" ] && export DOCKER_HOST="unix://$s" && break; done; docker ps -q --no-trunc | xargs -r docker inspect --format '{{.Image}} {{.Id}}'
    ;;
  docker-images)
    [ $# -eq 0 ] || die 'bad args'
    [ -n "${DOCKER_HOST:-}" ] || [ -S /var/run/docker.sock ] || for s in /run/user/*/docker.sock; do [ -S "$s" ] && export DOCKER_HOST="unix://$s" && break; done; docker image ls -q --no-trunc | sort -u | xargs -r docker image inspect
    ;;
  docker-cp)
    [ $# -eq 2 ] || die 'bad args'
    printf '%s' "$1" | grep -Eqx '[0-9a-f]{64}' || die 'bad arg 1'
    case "$2" in /etc/os-release|/usr/lib/os-release|/etc/debian_version|/etc/lsb-release|/etc/alpine-release|/etc/redhat-release|/var/lib/dpkg/status|/var/lib/dpkg/status.d|/lib/apk/db/installed|/var/lib/rpm|/usr/lib/sysimage/rpm) ;; *) die 'bad arg 2' ;; esac
    [ -n "${DOCKER_HOST:-}" ] || [ -S /var/run/docker.sock ] || for s in /run/user/*/docker.sock; do [ -S "$s" ] && export DOCKER_HOST="unix://$s" && break; done; docker cp -L "$1:$2" -
    ;;
  docker-save)
    [ $# -eq 1 ] || die 'bad args'
    printf '%s' "$1" | grep -Eqx 'sha256:[0-9a-f]{64}' || die 'bad arg 1'
    [ -n "${DOCKER_HOST:-}" ] || [ -S /var/run/docker.sock ] || for s in /run/user/*/docker.sock; do [ -S "$s" ] && export DOCKER_HOST="unix://$s" && break; done; docker save "$1"
    ;;
  swarm-info)
    [ $# -eq 0 ] || die 'bad args'
    [ -n "${DOCKER_HOST:-}" ] || [ -S /var/run/docker.sock ] || for s in /run/user/*/docker.sock; do [ -S "$s" ] && export DOCKER_HOST="unix://$s" && break; done; docker info --format '{{json .Swarm}}'
    ;;
  swarm-nodes)
    [ $# -eq 0 ] || die 'bad args'
    [ -n "${DOCKER_HOST:-}" ] || [ -S /var/run/docker.sock ] || for s in /run/user/*/docker.sock; do [ -S "$s" ] && export DOCKER_HOST="unix://$s" && break; done; docker node ls --format '{{json .}}'
    ;;
  swarm-services)
    [ $# -eq 0 ] || die 'bad args'
    [ -n "${DOCKER_HOST:-}" ] || [ -S /var/run/docker.sock ] || for s in /run/user/*/docker.sock; do [ -S "$s" ] && export DOCKER_HOST="unix://$s" && break; done; docker service ls --format '{{json .}}'
    ;;
  version) echo 1.2.3 ;;
  *) die "unknown operation '$op'" ;;
esac
